answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Median first divergence is 1 and edit distance is 0.758, close to the system-prompted pattern (0 and 0.79-0.82). Quantized (10-17, 0.52-0.57) and fine-tuned (5.5-8, 0.56-0.65) both diverge much later and less. The text shifts also point to a hidden instruction: refusals added rose to 8 (20.3% vs 7.8%), disclaimers tripled (20.3% vs 6.2%), and very short replies rose to 25%, with mean length down to 52.9. Fine-tuning is the main alternative, since it can add refusals, but it usually adds at most 4 and its divergence is later. Exact-match of 0.016 fits quantized or fine-tuned, but the other values do not. No logit or activation data were available to confirm, so confidence is moderate.
